But that fear turned into a journey, and this talk is that journey distilled. 

I walk the audience through the key AI trends shaping our industry today, the seven skills I believe every developer needs to build up, and how AI is already reshaping the way we write, test, and ship software. I also share the pitfalls I've seen teams fall into when using AI just because it's trendy, without grounding it in real customer problems. My closing message: start small, build something real, and share it with the community. There's still so much room for Indonesian developers to own this space, and this is our moment.
